import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 250010;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] bits = new int[MAXN];
    static long[][] x = new long[26][MAXN];
    static long[] fact = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] invFact = new long[MAXN];
    static long base, result;
    static final int SIZE = (1 << 19) + 1;
    static char[] buffer = new char[SIZE];
    static int ptr = 0, end = 0;
    static char[] obuf = new char[SIZE];
    static int obPtr = 0;

    static int gc() throws IOException {
        if (ptr == end) {
            end = 0;
            int read = System.in.read(buffer);
            if (read == -1) return -1;
            end = read;
            ptr = 0;
        }
        return buffer[ptr++];
    }

    static void readInt(IntHolder x) throws IOException {
        int flag = 1;
        int c = gc();
        while (c < '0' || c > '9') {
            if (c == '-') flag = -1;
            c = gc();
        }
        long res = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            res = res * 10 + (c & 15);
            c = gc();
        }
        x.value = (int) (res * flag);
    }

    static long qpow(long baseVal, int y) {
        long res = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) res = res * baseVal % p;
            baseVal = baseVal * baseVal % p;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long compute(int depth, int num) {
        if (bits[num] < depth) return 0;
        if (depth == 1) return x[depth][num];
        if (x[depth][num] != 0) return x[depth][num];
        int count = 0;
        int mask = num & (num - 1);
        while (mask != 0) {
            if (bits[mask] >= depth - 1) {
                x[depth][num] += compute(depth - 1, mask) * x[num ^ mask][num];
                if (++count == 18) {
                    count = 0;
                    x[depth][num] %= p;
                }
            }
            mask = (mask - 1) & num;
        }
        x[depth][num] %= p;
        return x[depth][num];
    }

    static long choose(int n, int m) {
        return fact[n] * invFact[m] % p * invFact[n - m] % p;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        // Reading input
        IntHolder nhp = new IntHolder();
        readInt(nhp);
        n = nhp.value;
        readInt(nhp);
        k = nhp.value;
        readInt(nhp);
        p = nhp.value;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            bits[i] = bits[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }

        base = qpow(k, n);
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println((int) base);
            return;
        }

        int limit = Math.min(k, bits[n]);
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p;
        }
        invFact[n] = qpow(fact[n], p - 2);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p;
        }

        result = 0;
        for (int i = limit; i >= 1; i--) {
            result += choose(k, i) * compute(i, n);
        }
        result %= p;
        base = (base - result * fact[n] % p + p) % p;
        System.out.println(base);
    }

    static class IntHolder {
        int value;
    }
}
